function: Channel estimation: a DnCNN estimates the quasi-static cascaded RIS1-BS channel and a GRU estimates the time-varying UE-RIS1 channel in a two-timescale scheme (pp. 3, 7-8).
system: mmWave 60 GHz OFDM uplink: 64-antenna UPA BS, 16 single-antenna mobile UEs, two reflecting RISs with 256 elements each, no direct link, 500 MHz (pp. 4, 10).
method: Supervised DnCNN (3 conv layers, batch norm, residual learning) for the quasi-static channel plus GRU (6 layers) for the time-varying channel, trained on ray-tracing pairs (pp. 7-11).
data_channel: DeepMIMO O1_60 outdoor ray-tracing scenario (60 GHz, Wireless InSite), 20,000 input-output pairs, 70% training and 30% validation; system model uses Saleh-Valenzuela channel (pp. 5, 10).
test_conditions: Training and validation split of one DeepMIMO double-RIS scenario (16 UEs); test set not described, NMSE swept over SNR -10 to 15 dB; no other scenario (pp. 10-11).
baselines: Non-learned: LMMSE estimator and oracle LS (lower bound). Learned: CNN-SC from [31] (double-RIS CNN with skip connection) (p. 11).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR (Eq. 25); training-loss convergence versus learning rate, number of conv layers and GRU layers (pp. 10-12).
complexity: Big-O order of online complexity of DnCNN, GRU and overall Algorithm 1 given; no FLOPs, parameters or runtime (p. 12).
q1_support: p. 10: "the DeepMIMO dataset [42] is utilised for training the proposed algorithms"; the O1_60 ray-tracing scenario is adopted, although Section II writes a Saleh-Valenzuela model.
q2_support: p. 10: "the training and validation datasets are 70% and 30% of the total generated dataset"; p. 11: "The NMSE performance is investigated for different SNR levels"; no new scenario, band, UE number or RIS size is tested.
q3_support: p. 11: "The proposed DnCNN-GRU performs better than both the CNN-SC and LMMSE in terms of NMSE"; LMMSE is classical and CNN-SC is the earlier learned double-RIS estimator of [31].
q4_support: p. 12: "The overall online complexity of the proposed DnCNN-GRU scheme can be analysed from Algorithm 1"; the order of complexity of each stage and the overall order are given.
q5_support: p. 10: "the DeepMIMO dataset [42] is utilised for training the proposed algorithms"; DeepMIMO is a public ray-tracing dataset; the paper releases no code of its own.
notes: Title and DOI on p. 1 match. Area 2: cascaded channel estimation, not RIS configuration. q1 and q5 rest on the DeepMIMO O1_60 scenario (p. 10) while the system model of Section II is a Saleh-Valenzuela geometric channel; the paper never describes a separate test set, so test data are taken from the same scenario. Only double-RIS results are given; generalisation to K RISs is only discussed (p. 4).
